query.sql_select_query:
SELECT
    -- Contact__c
    map_contacts.TargetId AS Contact__c,
    
    -- CreatedById
    COALESCE(map_users_created_by.TargetId, '#{_dp('{"pill_type":"project_property","property_name":"default_user"}')}') AS CreatedById,
     
    -- CreatedDate
    source.CreatedDate,
     
    -- ExternalId__c
    map_groups.TargetId || ':' || map_contacts.TargetId AS ExternalId__c,
     
    -- Group__c
    map_groups.TargetId AS Group__c,
    
    -- LastModifiedById
    COALESCE(map_users_last_modified_by.TargetId, '#{_dp('{"pill_type":"project_property","property_name":"default_user"}')}') AS LastModifiedById,
     
    -- LastModifiedDate
    source.LastModifiedDate,
     
    -- LegacyID__c
    source.Id AS LegacyID__c,
     
    -- Member__c
    map_users_member.TargetId AS Member__c    

FROM
    source

INNER JOIN map_groups
    ON source.Group__c = map_groups.SourceId

INNER JOIN map_contacts
    ON source.Contact__c = map_contacts.SourceId

LEFT JOIN map_users map_users_created_by
    ON source.CreatedById = map_users_created_by.SourceId

LEFT JOIN map_users map_users_last_modified_by
    ON source.LastModifiedById = map_users_last_modified_by.SourceId

INNER JOIN map_users map_users_member
    ON source.Contact__c = map_users_member.SourceId
